description: DONE. Residual exposed by task #34 at parity-random-save-replays-60s-15x/Savegame_nicouzouf/Profile_001/Savegame_069/replay-005. The two frame-463 fields were separate. Pc247's Original motion_state was 4160286488, outside the complete RHSprite.h RHmotionState range 0..=5: RHElementActorPC::Perform(RHANIMATION_STRANGLING) can return its uninitialized local while TurnFast short-circuits, and the schema-12 recorder captured those stack bytes.
